query:
select clock_timestamp() observed_at,
(select count(*) from facetime_calls where status not in ('ended','failed','rejected')) nonterminal_calls,
(select count(*) from facetime_sessions where cleaned_at is null) uncleaned_sessions,
(select count(*) from facetime_worker_commands where status in ('queued','leased')) executable_commands,
(select count(*) from facetime_workers where current_call_id is not null) worker_reservations,
(select count(*) from facetime_lines where current_call_id is not null) line_reservations,
(select count(*) from facetime_session_credential_seals where state not in ('tombstoned','consumed')) unconsumed_seals,
(select count(*) from facetime_session_credential_seals where livekit_url_ciphertext is not null or participant_token_ciphertext is not null) seals_with_ciphertext,
(select count(*) from facetime_development_windows where expires_at>now() and consumed_at is null) open_development_windows,
(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('status',status,'count',n)) from (select status,count(*) n from facetime_calls group by status)c) call_status_counts,
(select jsonb_build_object('state',state,'cleaned_at',cleaned_at,'project_id',project_id) from facetime_sessions where id='53945278-4dcf-4a4d-817a-73702d67799d') historical_session;
